neighbours.label: the token ' subsidy'
fire: Each farmer received a small subsidy from the government to cover fuel costs.
The city pays a subsidy of forty percent toward every bus ticket sold.
Critics argued that the housing subsidy mostly benefited landlords.
Without the federal subsidy the rural airport would have closed years ago.
The company lost its export subsidy when the trade rules changed.
Parents can apply for a childcare subsidy through the local council.
Economists debated whether the fuel subsidy should be phased out slowly.
The theater survived the recession thanks to an arts subsidy from the state.
